Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1987
PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1987
ACT XIII OF 1987
An Act to amend the Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 16th November, 1987]
Whereas it is expedient to amend the Prevention of Gambling Act,
1977 (XXVIII of 1977), for the purpose hereinafter, appearing:
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This
Act maybe called the Prevention of Gambling (Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It extends to the Islamabad Capital Territory.
(3) It shall come into force at once.
